fact: FinScope reports that 73% of Rwandan adults use services such as mobile money (KT Press, reporting FinScope; survey year not given).
MINECOFIN, launching the FinScope 2024 survey, says the share of adults holding registered mobile money accounts rose from 60% in 2020 to 77% in 2024, with 22% banked.
MINECOFIN, launching the FinScope 2024 survey, says formal financial inclusion among Rwandan adults rose from 77% in 2020 to 92% (7.5 million) in 2024, driven mainly by mobile money.
